additional_info.subject: Recurring Backend Disconnection - Charger Y2 / R2 312900727020
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
We are experiencing a recurring communication issue with charger Y2 / R2 (Serial Number: 312900727020).
In recent days, the charger has been disconnecting from the backend on a daily basis.
Please note:
Performing a remote reboot via the SIFINITY system does not restore communication.
The charger reconnects to the backend only after a full local power reset (complete power disconnection).
After the local reset, communication is restored and operates normally until the next disconnection event.
Based on our initial assessment, this behavior suggests a potential issue related to the communication router or network configuration at the site.
We kindly request that you investigate this matter as soon as possible and resolve the issue completely.
We will be happy to provide logs or any additional diagnostic information required from our side.
Best regards,
Ziv

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0481846-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727020] Recurring Backend Disconnection CRM:03056001089
additional_info.body:
Dear Orel,
I am reaching out in regards of this ticket
ID0481846
opened by end customer for OCPP disconnections on charger
Y2/R2 312900727020.
I analyzed the recurring OCPP disconnections, and noticed that the only symptom displayed is logged as "Connection closed because of missing Pong from server." If at a first glance this could look like an issue from CPO Backend side, I am escalating the topic to R&D to support the analysis and verify if the disconnections could be generated by the charger unable to keep the communication channel opened.
I will provide you feedback as soon as there is an update from R&D side.
With kind regards,
